purpose: City-specific discovery of an official cadastral parcel source for Ad-Damazin, Sudan; access limitations are not treated as evidence of citywide parcel absence.
name: Ad-Damazin

queries.query: Ad-Damazin Sudan cadastral parcel map land registry official Blue Nile Survey Authority GIS
queries.result: Found the official Sudan National Information Center description of the Sudan Spatial Portal, which advertises WMS/WFS, but no reachable parcel layer or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was established. Search results also included administrative-boundary maps, not cadastral parcels.

queries.query: السودان الدمازين السجل العقاري المساحة الأراضي خريطة قطع الأراضي ولاية النيل الأزرق
queries.result: Found the official NIC spatial-portal page in Arabic and a secondary Arabic publication whose map cites the Damazin Survey Office as the source for a locality map. Neither exposed an anonymous cadastral parcel service, schema, native parcel ID, or parcel polygon.

registryBasis: The official NIC page establishes a national spatial-portal project and advertises OGC WMS/WFS, but does not identify a Damazin local registry custodian or prove that a public parcel layer is currently available. The secondary map citation to a Damazin Survey Office is not sufficient first-party registry evidence.
